title: Quality Caramelized British Lamb Shepherds Pie
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring caramelized lamb and tomato puree, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is diabetic-friendly and made with fresh ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the lamb mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the tomato puree, carrots, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the lamb mixture is cooking, boil the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with a fork until smooth.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish and top with the mashed potatoes.
Bake the shepherds pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
